notes.title: Blue Light Patch July 21, 2025
notes.notes:
- Fixed all animations in cutscenes that broke after the last update. 

- The volume of the jumpscares has been reduced significantly, and now their volume can be adjusted through the "effects" in menu. 

- The game's performance has been improved by using a less demanding method for rendering shadows. 

- The monster's speed has been reduced to avoid creating an imbalance with the player.

notes.title: Blue Light Patch June 7, 2025
notes.notes: [p]- Fixed the issues of crash and endless black screen after death from a monster. [/p][p]- Replaced the sounds of the main menu.  - Fixed a zone where the monster couldn't attack you.[/p][p]- Fixed minor bugs in Asian localizations where some buttons and texts disappeared due to inappropriate font.[/p]

notes.title: Blue Light Update v. 2.0.0.2 February 4, 2025
notes.notes:
- Added vibration for Xbox gamepads (during screamers, thunderstorms, passing cars, etc.) Works with both USB and Bluetooth connectivity.

- NVIDIA Reflex technology has been added (reduces input delay). The technology is embedded in the game and will always be enabled.

- Fixed incorrect aspect ratio on ultra-wide monitors. The frame is no longer cropped and will adjust to the resolution of the monitor.

- The graphics have been changed at level 5 in order to equate fps to the level of the stated system requirements. (The level was too demanding).

notes.title: BLUE LIGHT v.2.0.0.1: New update from December 4:
notes.notes:
! After the update, it is recommended to reset the gameplay settings to default.
List of changes:
Localization:
- Added support for the following languages:
• Chinese (Simplified)
• Japanese
• Korean
• Portuguese (Brazil)
• Spanish
• (Achievements are localized accordingly)
- Note textures are now also localized (First, it is recommended to reset the language settings to default)
- German and French localization has been slightly corrected

Functionality:

- Added a setting for changing the brightness
- Added the ability to reset the graphics, sound, control and gameplay settings to default

Steam Store Page:
- A small cover with supported technologies and languages ​​has been added to the Steam Store page.

Soundtrack:
- One of the tracks on level 3 is no longer overloaded
- The track in the end credits has been replaced with the game's main theme

Levels:
- Rain and lighting on level 3 have been slightly improved
- Vegetation on level 4 will no longer load in front of your nose
- The image on level 4 has been slightly improved to better convey the effect of the past.
- The issue where the park's ambient sound ended on level 4 has been fixed
- The sun rays have been brought back on level 4

UI:
- The interface text color has been changed to a whiter color
- The values ​​of all sliders are now not as large and have been rounded to tenths.
- The loading screen has become a little more interesting
- Some level pictures in the "Continue Game" section have become less dull
- The sound of pressing a button in the menu is no longer so drawn out

Other:
- The vignette effect is now set to 2.5 by default
- The grain effect can now be turned up to a maximum of 6[img]https://www.imghippo.com/i/MCju9582yAA.png[/img]

notes.title: Blue Light update from October 8th
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the progress in the hospital was not reset even after the progress was reset from menu

notes.title: Blue Light Update 1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
- Added German localization (achievements are also localized).

- Slightly increased brightness at the hospital level.

- Added missing subtitles in some places.

- Slightly increased performance at level 1.

- Fixed a lot of minor bugs in the level design

New languages are planned to be added in the upcoming updates.

notes.title: BLUE LIGHT Update 1.0.0.2 (October 2nd)
notes.notes:
- Complaints about the brightness of the game were taken into account.

- Fixed the "save zone" when entering which the monster could not attack you.

- At levels 3 and 6, the character can now accelerate, so as not to delay the passage time.
